verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a REST API reference, a CLI, an MCP server and an llms.txt, but the evidence never shows a downloadable machine-readable API spec. A probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate. llms.txt is a docs index, not an API spec, and the CLI and MCP server are adjacent features that do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
